data.name: Chhaayank
data.gender_notes: Chhaayank is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: In Sanskrit, Chhaayank refers to one who protects or casts a shadow. It is derived from the root word 'chhaaya' which means shadow or protection. This name is deeply rooted in Hindu mythology where gods and goddesses often provide chhaaya (shadow or protection) to their devotees. The name Chhaayank carries the meaning “Shadow, Protector” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Chhaayank usually hope their child will grow to embody shadow, protector and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Chhaayank belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Shadow, Protector.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Chhaayank total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

historical_references.reference: Chhaayank was a great Hindu king of the Chhattisgarh region in central India. He ruled in the late 13th century during the rule of the Yadava dynasty.

historical_references.reference: Another reference suggests that Chhaayank was a commander in the army of Prithviraj Chauhan III, the last Hindu king of Delhi before the Muslim invasion by the Khilji dynasty in 1290.
